pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular, stellate to polygonal geometry with soft, blurred pixel-gradient edges. Patch size is largest on the mid-neck and decreases in spatial area toward the posterior flank and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways with significant pixel thickness relative to patch size. The network is characterized by frequent tri-radiate junction nodes and maintains high topological connectivity across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the superior neck margin appears as a dark, thin profile with low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations visible against the blurred background.
